$comment: Dependency advisories deliberately not fixed yet, each with a review date.
The verification command blocks on any high or critical advisory in a shipped
dependency. An entry here suppresses one — but only until its `expires` date, after
which the gate fails on the exception itself. That is the point: a deferral becomes a
decision with a review date rather than a permanent hole nobody revisits.
Add an entry only when the advisory is genuinely unreachable from how this project
uses the package, and say why in `rationale` — 'not exploitable here' is not a
rationale, it is a claim. Name the code path.
The list is empty because the tree is clean: `npm audit` reports zero vulnerabilities
